meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'третиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to meet', paired with 'встречаться'.

examples.text: Я очень хочу с вами встретиться.
examples.trans: I really want to meet with you.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'пытаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to try, attempt'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и попытаться вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and to try on time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'бедить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to convince', paired with 'убеждать'.

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement
meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'говориться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'agreed, deal', paired with 'договариваться'.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
